tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Run every email-authentication check on a domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, plus domain and mail-server blacklists) and return a score out of 100, per-check findings and a prioritized fix list. Use this first when asked whether a domain is set up correctly to send email.

tools.name: check_record
tools.description: Look up and validate a single email DNS record for a domain, explaining each tag. record is one of spf, dmarc, dkim, bimi, mta-sts, tls-rpt, mx. SPF counts the 10-lookup limit; DMARC checks policy, reporting and external report authorization; DKIM sizes the key; MTA-STS fetches the policy file and c

tools.name: check_blacklists
tools.description: Check an IPv4 address against about 18 IP blacklists (SpamCop, Barracuda, UCEPROTECT, PSBL, Mailspike, ...) or a domain against domain blacklists. Each list is verified with its test entries first, so lists that refuse public resolvers (such as Spamhaus) are reported as unavailable rather than clean

tools.name: analyze_headers
tools.description: Parse raw email headers: the Received delivery path with per-hop delays, the receiving server's SPF/DKIM/DMARC verdicts, DMARC alignment of the From domain, DKIM signatures, the sending IP, and bulk-sender requirements such as one-click unsubscribe.

tools.name: check_spam_words
tools.description: Scan an email subject and body (plain text or HTML) for spam-trigger phrases by category, ALL-CAPS, exclamation runs, emoji, URL shorteners and image-heavy HTML. Returns a low/medium/high risk reading and, optionally, a rule-based rewrite.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_record" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_domain, check_record, check_spam_words · Private data: check_record · Public sink: check_domain, check_record, analyze_headers, check_spam_words · Destructive: check_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_domain, check_record, check_spam_words · Private data: check_record · Public sink: check_domain, check_record, analyze_headers, check_spam_words · Destructive: check_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
